import io
import unittest

from pyflakes import api, reporter


class VepExtra(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_unused_import_is_reported_once(self):
        out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
        n = api.check('import os\n', 'x.py', reporter.Reporter(out, err))
        self.assertEqual(n, 1)
        self.assertIn('imported but unused', out.getvalue())
